# Chatbotkit

ChatBotKit is a platform that enables developers to build and manage AI-powered chatbots, offering comprehensive APIs and SDKs for seamless integration into applications.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/chatbotkit/.

## Actions

- **Complete Conversation**: Send a message to a conversation and receive the bot’s reply.
- **Create Integration**: Create a new integration.
- **Create Skillset**: Create a new skillset.
- **List Bots**: Retrieve a paginated list of all bots.
- **List conversation messages**: List messages in a conversation with pagination.
- **List Conversations**: Retrieve a paginated list of conversations.
- **List Datasets**: List datasets.
- **List Integrations**: Retrieve a list of trigger integrations.
- **List Partners**: Retrieve a list of all partner accounts associated with the main account.
- **List Skillsets**: Retrieve a list of all skillsets available in the system.
- **List Tokens**: Retrieve a list of all api tokens.
